topic: how much Meta has lost on its virtual reality division in a single year
storyAngle: Meta spends billions a year on a division that sells a tiny fraction of that back.
doNotClaim: Operating loss is an accounting loss, not cash burned.
Do not say Meta as a whole loses money, and do not call Reality Labs a failure.

facts.claim: Meta Reality Labs segment operating loss for full-year 2024 was about $17.7 billion.
facts.note: nine-month 2024 loss of $12,762M is in the Q3 exhibit; Q4 coverage adds about $4.97B; confirm in Meta 10-K before long-form use

facts.claim: Meta Reality Labs segment revenue for full-year 2024 was about $2.1 billion.
facts.note: nine-month revenue $1,063M plus Q4 about $1.08B; confirm in 10-K

facts.claim: Meta Reality Labs operating loss for full-year 2023 was about $16.2 billion.

derived.claim: The 2024 Reality Labs operating loss was roughly eight times its revenue (17.7 / 2.1).
